educationalGoal: To get a teacher's license, five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools are required. advice:
1. Pre-guidance
Students will understand the significance of the experience of nursing care, and acquire basic knowledge of social welfare, special needs education, handicapped people, and elderly people.

2. The experience of nursing care
Students will participate in five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools

3. Post-guidance
For reflection on the experience of nursing care, students will discuss each experience and build the view of education and human based on the discussion.
books: The Understand for Special Needed Child: Useful Knoeledge and Skill for Nursing Care, Itsukki-Shobou (Tokubetsu no Kyouiku-teki Needs no Aru Kodomo no Rikai, Itsuki-Shobou.)
requiredKnowledge:

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the significance of the experience of nursing care.
Be able to answer the basic questions on social welfare and special need education.
Be able to answer the questions on social welfare facilities and special need school.
Be able to explain the suitable attitude which is required for the meaningful experience of nursing care.
Be able to explain the view of education and human based on the reflection on the experience of nursing care.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

              To get a teacher's license, five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools are required. This course consists of three parts. One is Pre-guidance for final preparation of the experience of nursing care, second is experience of nursing care, and the last is Post-guidance for reflection on the experience of nursing care. In Pre-guidance, students will acquire.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              1. Pre-guidance
Students will understand the significance of the experience of nursing care, and acquire basic knowledge of social welfare, special needs education, handicapped people, and elderly people.

2. The experience of nursing care
Students will participate in five days of nursing care experience at social welfare facilities and two days of nursing care at special needs schools

3. Post-guidance
For reflection on the experience of nursing care, students will discuss each experience and build the view of education and human based on the discussion.
